outcome: mothers' perceptions about childbirth preparation classes
cohort: Participants included 18 women who had given birth in the last six months in a Tehran hospital (at least 20 days post-delivery), along with five husbands, two midwives, and two obstetricians.
finding: Childbirth preparation classes can meaningfully contribute to making motherhood a pleasant experience and are perceived to improve family health.
mod_finding: One sub-theme related to 'good termination' was the perception of free and conscious choice for birth mode.
